name: video-use
one_liner: A tool that turns a folder of raw phone or camera footage into a finished, edited video by just chatting with an AI agent — no video-editing software needed.
buyer: A solo YouTuber, course creator, or small business owner who films their own talking-head or tutorial videos but doesn't have time or budget to hire an editor.
business_use_cases: A solo content creator drops a week's raw footage in a folder and gets a cut, captioned, color-graded video back by chatting with the agent instead of hiring an editor.
A course creator turns raw lecture recordings into polished lesson videos with subtitles and animated overlays automatically.
A small business owner turns product-demo footage into short social clips without learning editing software.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'done for you' video-editing subscription for creators using this pipeline behind the scenes.
Run it as a paid editing service via the hosted Browser Use Cloud offering for clients who don't want to self-host.

steal_this: Set it up this weekend on a friend's backlog of unedited footage, deliver a finished video same-day, and use that as the demo to sell a 'video editing, but instant' service to local creators.
